ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Input Cable Tester

2. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

3. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

4. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.

5. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.

8. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

12. When learning Cells and Batteries, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cells and Batteries.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cells and Batteries.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Cells and Batteries.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Inductors and inductance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Information and Communication Technology

2. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

3. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.

6. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

9. A — CPU

10. D — Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

12. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cells and Batteries.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Installation. 3.1 Generation, Transmissi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Inductors and inductance; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity 3.2 Equipment at the Co; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electricity; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
